a.lede: Despite pressure from President Trump, Elon Musk, and Silicon Valley executives, Nvidia’s board says it “does not intend” to reinstate the company’s ousted CEO.
a.title: Nvidia’s Board Has No Plans to Bring Back Jensen Huang

b.lede: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday amid the dramatic exit of ex-CEO Jensen Huang.
b.title: Nvidia reports bumper results as firm says it's not reinstating Huang
